## Anas v5.2.5

- 用量仪表新增小米 MiMo：普通 API 显示扣除冻结金额后的可用余额及明细；个人 Token Plan 显示剩余比例、Credits、计费周期和自动续费状态，支持中国、新加坡和欧洲节点。

- Added Xiaomi MiMo to Usage Meter: ordinary API accounts show spendable balance after frozen funds and a balance breakdown; personal Token Plans show remaining percentage, Credits, billing period, and auto-renew status across China, Singapore, and Europe endpoints.
